tvShow.name: Only Murders in the Building
tvShow.overview: Three strangers share an obsession with true crime and suddenly find themselves wrapped up in one.

episodes.name: True Crime
episodes.overview: Upper West Side neighbors Charles, Oliver & Mabel bond over a shared love of true crime. When a fellow resident dies in their building, the trio determine to solve the mystery and record an accompanying podcast.

episodes.name: Who Is Tim Kono?
episodes.overview: The group begins researching the victim. Meanwhile, Mabel’s secretive past starts to be unraveled.

episodes.name: How Well Do You Know Your Neighbors?
episodes.overview: Oliver employs his theater director skills to analyze the case. Charles & Mabel question an obsessive cat lover.

episodes.name: The Sting
episodes.overview: Believing the murderer might be a famous resident whom is difficult to access, the group seeks advice from a renowned podcasting host.

episodes.name: Twist
episodes.overview: Mabel slips away on a solo mission tracking the victim's final days. Suspicious, Charles & Oliver follow her.

episodes.name: To Protect and Serve
episodes.overview: Mabel brings her new friends (and an old one) to her childhood home to meet her mother. Meanwhile, Detective Williams starts to have her own doubts about the case as she prepares for motherhood.

episodes.name: The Boy from 6B
episodes.overview: With the investigation scratching at a web of old crimes originating inside the building, a mysterious young man turns the tables to spy on Charles, Oliver & Mabel.

episodes.name: Fan Fiction
episodes.overview: Hitting a dead end, the group calls for reinforcements in the form of their podcast’s Superfans.

episodes.name: Double Time
episodes.overview: With the residents growing upset at the building’s negative publicity, the trio faces a revolt. Charles is visited by an old colleague who sheds light on his past.

episodes.name: Open and Shut
episodes.overview: In the season finale, the trio races toward a resolution while their own lives are put in danger.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a grisly death occurs inside their exclusive Upper West Side apartment building, three strangers who share an obsession with true crime suspect murder and employ their precise knowledge of true crime to investigate the truth. As they record a podcast of their own to document the case, the three unravel the complex secrets of the building which stretch back years. Perhaps even more explosive are the lies they tell one another. Soon, the endangered trio comes to realize a killer might be living amongst them as they race to decipher the mounting clues before it’s too late.

episodes.name: Persons of Interest
episodes.overview: Welcome home, Arconiacs!  Minutes after Season 1’s finale, Charles, Oliver and Mabel are now implicated in the murder of Board President, Bunny Folger.  They must choose whether to lay low or risk their safety by catching the killer themselves.

episodes.name: Framed
episodes.overview: A memorial for Bunny provides an opportunity for our trio to question their neighbors, while they also try to get rid of a very implicating piece of evidence.  One of Bunny’s relatives makes an appearance and if you thought Bunny was a force, get ready...

episodes.name: The Last Day of Bunny Folger
episodes.overview: A foul-mouthed parrot becomes a critical window into Bunny Folger’s last day on Earth.  Some of the individuals with whom Bunny crossed paths will surprise both you and our trio... Along the way, a reveal deepens our trio's need to solve Bunny's case.

episodes.name: Here's Looking at You
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver and Mabel welcome an unexpected young visitor who reveals hidden secrets about the inner workings of the Arconia.  We also discover Charles once recorded a hit single that was huge in Germany.

episodes.name: The Tell
episodes.overview: Mabel hosts a party for an electric art crowd which also serves a double purpose for smoking on a liar in the trios’s midst.

episodes.name: Performance Review
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver and Mabel collide with their podcasting mentor-turned-competitor, Cinda Canning.  Subsequently, a key clue requires the trio to orchestrate a classic stakeout — Brazzos-style.  New York has never been more glittering.

episodes.name: Flipping the Pieces
episodes.overview: Mabel’s incident on the subway leads her to gain help from an unlikely ally.  Their journey takes them to a legendary amusement park which turns out to be full of terror — while amusements and evidence reside back in the Arconia with Charles and Oliver.

episodes.name: Hello, Darkness
episodes.overview: A blackout throws the city into chaos.  As the trio races to save a loved one from the killer, other Arconia residents begin to explore unexpected connections in the midst of darkness — all enhanced by Gut Milk and a yodel or two.

episodes.name: Sparring Partners
episodes.overview: Closing in on the killer, Mabel takes her investigative talents into the ring.  Oliver and Charles duke it out over a birdcage only to end up confronting their deepest paternal struggles.

episodes.name: I Know Who Did It
episodes.overview: One question remains: Who did it??? Oh, who are we kidding -- there's a few more questions raised, too.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 picks up with the trio following the shocking death of Arconia Board President Bunny Folger, as they race to unmask her killer. However, three (unfortunate) complications ensue—the trio is publicly implicated in Bunny’s homicide, they are now the subjects of a competing podcast, and they have to deal with a bunch of New York neighbors who all think they committed murder.

episodes.name: The Show Must...
episodes.overview: Curtain up on Season 3! And Leading Man down! After Ben Glenroy's collapse on stage, Charles, Oliver & Mabel piece together the show’s first days with a suspicious cast & crew to determine if foul play was involved. Spoiler alert...

episodes.name: The Beat Goes On
episodes.overview: Mabel, Oliver & Charles attend Ben’s lavish memorial full of fans and those with more dubious motives. As the actor's sudden death is mourned, Oliver works to revive his shaky Broadway show.

episodes.name: Grab Your Hankies
episodes.overview: Oliver races to bring new life to his show as Mabel’s investigation into the actual murder collides with a surprising ally. Charles bonds with the cast, and Loretta proves her voice is invaluable.

episodes.name: The White Room
episodes.overview: Charles’s stage fright reaches unimaginable heights, involving a break from reality and multiple baby dolls. Mabel is confronted by a mysterious individual from her past with a pivotal proposal.

episodes.name: Ah, Love!
episodes.overview: Date night! New York proves itself both a jewel box and a fish tank of romance as Charles, Mabel & Oliver take their relationships to the next stage. And dating can reveal many hidden secrets, too...

episodes.name: Ghost Light
episodes.overview: All roads lead the trio back to the Goosebury Theater during a nerve-rattling thunderstorm. With Howard as their jittery guide, they track a legendary ghost who’s haunted the theater for generations. Boo.

episodes.name: CoBro
episodes.overview: Charles finds an unexpected source for a major clue. A Broadway icon comes knocking at Oliver’s door. And Mabel forms an alternate trio to pursue a lead that sheds light on Ben’s bro and CoBro history.

episodes.name: Sitzprobe
episodes.overview: On the day of the show’s most critical rehearsal, the pressure mounts. A familiar official returns to upend the case, Loretta’s complex past threatens to upend all else and Charles must finally sing his number without losing his marbles.

episodes.name: Thirty
episodes.overview: The trio have amassed a plethora (oh yes, a plethora) of clues, suspects & theories but find no concrete answers about Ben’s murder. They devise a peculiar method of throwing themselves into the actual case to recreate the final moments of Ben’s life.

episodes.name: Opening Night
episodes.overview: Curtain call on Season 3! Charles, Mabel & Oliver race to entrap the killer on Opening Night. As the musical thrills its Broadway audience, the trio brave further twists & turns from behind, above and all around the stage.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three finds Charles, Oliver & Mabel investigating a murder behind the scenes of a Broadway show. Ben Glenroy is a Hollywood action star whose Broadway debut is cut short by his untimely death. Aided by co-star Loretta Durkin, our trio embarks on their toughest case yet, all while director Oliver desperately attempts to put his show back together. Curtain up!

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time in the West
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel are whisked to Los Angeles where a legendary film studio intends to adapt their podcast. However, Hollywood's glitz is overshadowed by a stunning clue about Charles' stunt double & friend Sazz Pataki.

episodes.name: Gates of Heaven
episodes.overview: Mabel & Oliver begin investigating Arconia's West Tower and get trapped inside an ominous game. Meanwhile, Charles is visited by two individuals from his complex past.

episodes.name: Two for the Road
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel begrudgingly pair off with new investigators... actors Eugene Levy, Zach Galifianakis & Eva Longoria.

episodes.name: The Stunt Man
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel delve into the particular universe of stunt people. They encounter a suspect with an incredibly... familiar... face.

episodes.name: Adaptation
episodes.overview: The trio face off against a collection of individuals who deceive, manipulate, and threaten as second nature - a Hollywood cast & crew.

episodes.name: Blow-Up
episodes.overview: A documentary film is made by The Brothers Sisters.

episodes.name: Valley of the Dolls
episodes.overview: Terrified by a threat inside the Arconia, the trio race out of the city. A member of Charles' family provides refuge and yet, this safe house proves to be anything but.

episodes.name: Lifeboat
episodes.overview: Charles, Oliver & Mabel combine forces with the film actors in an epic showdown against the Westies. You can't handle the truth.

episodes.name: Escape from Planet Klongo
episodes.overview: Seeking a critical clue, Charles, Oliver & Mabel must infiltrate a film set to get the real "background" on why Sazz was killed.

episodes.name: My Best Friend's Wedding
episodes.overview: The final answers to our season are revealed - but not before the trio faces mortal danger and an Arconia wedding.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The trio investigates the mysterious murder of Sazz Pataki, Charles' stunt double, whose death raises questions about whether Sazz or Charles was the intended victim. The Arconia residents find themselves entangled in Hollywood drama as a studio adapts their podcast into a movie, leading to new faces and on-set chaos. As the action ramps up, the amateur sleuths return to New York, diving into the twisted lives of the Arconia's West Tower residents.

episodes.name: Nail in the Coffin
episodes.overview: While investigating Lester’s mysterious "accidental" death, the clues lure Charles, Oliver, and Mabel out of Manhattan — and straight into some dangerous new "old" territory.

episodes.name: After You
episodes.overview: A look back at Lester's early days at the Arconia reveals how a young dreamer became a steadfast doorman — sacrificing his future to protect the residents from the building’s secrets.

episodes.name: Rigor
episodes.overview: The trio stumbles upon a crucial piece of evidence... and promptly compromises it. With time running out, they scramble to solve the mystery before the police close in on them.

episodes.name: Dirty Birds
episodes.overview: Snooping goes sideways when three billionaire suspects catch the trio and invite themselves over for an evening at Oliver's.

episodes.name: Tongue Tied
episodes.overview: Thwarted in their investigative podcast plans, Mabel and Oliver look for help from the Arconia support staff — as Charles dines with another suspect and gets caught up in "catching" more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: Flatbush
episodes.overview: The investigation takes Oliver and Loretta back to the streets of his childhood, where buried memories surface and secrets about Lester and Nicky's widows emerge. Mabel and Charles follow leads after a break-in.

episodes.name: Silver Alert
episodes.overview: The mayor warns the trio about the billionaires, sending them to investigate further at a villainous lair upstate — as Oliver boots it in an attempted escape.

episodes.name: Cuckoo Chicks
episodes.overview: Mabel gathers a ragtag group to crash an exclusive ladies night. While trying to save the Arconia from being sold, Charles and Oliver accidentally end up in couples' therapy.

episodes.name: LESTR
episodes.overview: Told through the lens of one annoying robot who may hold the keys to more secrets than anyone realized — the Arconia throws one last party as the residents discover that a killer may still be in their building.

episodes.name: The House Always...
episodes.overview: With the clock ticking, the trio doubles down to bring "new" and "old" forces together to bring down a killer — ending in one explosive showdown and the reveals they've been chasing all season.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: After their beloved doorman, Lester, dies under suspicious circumstances, Charles, Oliver, and Mabel refuse to believe it was an accident. Their investigation plunges them into the shadowy corners of New York and beyond - where the trio uncovers a dangerous web of secrets connecting powerful billionaires, old-school mobsters, and the mysterious residents of the Arconia. The trio discovers a deeper divide between their storied city they thought they knew and the new New York evolving around them - one where the old mob fights to hold on as newer, even more dangerous players emerge.

seasons.name: Season 6: Only Murders in London
seasons.overview: After successfully bringing the guilty to justice once again, Charles, Oliver and Mabel embark on their hardest case yet when the next victim - Cinda Canning - arrives at their doorstep, summoning them to London to catch her killer. Our beloved trio of true crime-solving podcasters must now navigate their way through the home of the cozy murder mystery, replete with a whole new collection of suspicious and particularly English-eccentric characters. But can they follow in the footsteps of the woman whose podcast started it all for them ... without having their story end the same as hers?

reviews.author: RNDMRS
reviews.content: Only murders in the building is a masterpiece and should be an example of how a comedy should be written, it explores detailed plots whilst being light and upbeat, it is perplexing and fascinating to see the unraveling storyline highlight amazingly placed plot points.

reviews.author: SeanDillon
reviews.content: I don't know what all the hype is about. I had to stop watching by the third episode, I no longer cared about the plot or the characters. A serealistic, slow and badly written comedy. Truly one of the worst shows I've seen, and I've seen a lot. It's not common for me to drop at the beginning of the season (or at any point in the series). My advice is don't watch it.

reviews.author: tee.dias23@gmail.com
reviews.content: To the people who say it’s terrible, please just go sleep! This is the best series I’ve probably ever watched!! And YES I have good taste and YES I’ve watched ALOT of series!!! 😂 1000/1000 for me!! So excited for season 4😍
